item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 31/Mar/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An easterly airstream will affect the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, upper-air disturbances will continue to bring showers to Guangdong. Under the influence of a humid southerly airstream, it will be misty over the coast of Guangdong in the morning and at night early next week. The northeast monsoon is expected to bring slightly cooler weather to southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.
